description: Obtaining assistance of the OPEC Fund for International Development for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Reform for Growth, Resilience and Openness Development Policy Operation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka is implementing a comprehensive programme of economic stabilization, recovery and structural reforms aimed at restoring macroeconomic stability, ensuring fiscal sustainability and laying the foundation for sustainable and inclusive economic growth. Following a positive assessment of the said reform programme and policy commitments, the OPEC Fund for International Development has agreed to grant a Policy-Based Loan of USD 30 million. The said Loan Facility is to be provided in parallel with financial assistance provided by the World Bank under the Development Policy Operation. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development to obtain the said loan consisting of USD 24 million under Ordinary Capital Resources and USD 6 million under Special Capital Resources from the OPEC Fund for International Development, was approved by the Cabinet.
